_comment: Source rehabilitation lifecycle (owner master package 2026-10-17, Workstream J). EVERY source that is ingested but not voting at full authority has an entry: why, the evidence, the named recovery action, who/what owns it, the next evaluation trigger, the promotion gate, and a review-by date. 'permanent_role' entries (benchmarks, mirrors, seasonal-lane boards) are not candidates and carry no gate. Owner module: src/sources/rehabilitation.py. Pinned by tests/sources/test_rehabilitation_registry.py (every held / non-voting / shadow key must appear). Overdue entries are reported by scripts/check_source_health.py. An entry never makes a source vote: activation stays behind its own gate and, where stated, owner approval.

idpShowCombined.reason: collection RECOVERED: the prod collector (dynasty-idpshow-fetch) has authenticated and committed every 2 h since 2026-10-17T20:32Z (665 rows, HEALTHY). The vendor's combined chart U8I37 is still v4, lastModifiedAt 2026-08-19, so freshness weighting quarantines it (freshness 0, ~60 days old) — the established safeguard
idpShowCombined.recoveryAction: none on our side; the quarantine lifts automatically when the vendor publishes a new chart version. When it votes again it votes as its OWN family beside the IDP Trade Calculator (owner directive 2026-10-19: agreement between providers is consensus; the Decision 2 shared cap was withdrawn before release, docs/sources/SOURCE_VOTING_CONSENSUS_2026-10-19.md)
idpShowCombined.nextTrigger: vendor publishes U8I37 v5 or later (each 2-hourly fetch reads the chart version)
idpShowCombined.promotionGate: freshness weighting releases the quarantine only when the vendor's chart lastModifiedAt advances; a re-fetch of an unchanged chart stays stale

It carries no information beyond a voter that already counts
idpShow.recoveryAction: do NOT make this IDP-only cut an additional voter (same provider as idpShowCombined: one family vote for the provider, closeout 2026-10-18). Its order similarity to the IDP Trade Calculator is a diagnostic only and merges no vote (owner directive 2026-10-19, docs/sources/SOURCE_VOTING_CONSENSUS_2026-10-19.md)
idpShow.nextTrigger: a measured divergence of the two IDP orders (owner closeout Decision 2: the IDP-only board must not become an additional voter)
